directives.trigger: A candidate list (papers, records, datasets) and a written inclusion rule file are both present. Quiet when the rule is only in someone's head, or for deep reading.
directives.doneWhen: A program reads the rule file and triage table: every row is included, excluded, or unread; each included row cites the rule id that admits it and each excluded row cites the rule id that excludes it, a row with no rule id fails; included count is at most the cap; included + excluded + unread equals the candidate total; unread ids are listed. Empty included set with unread rows is a valid result.
directives.forbidden: Including a paper because it is interesting when no rule id admits it; excluding by vibe with no rule id; silently dropping what was not read instead of recording it as unread.

directives.trigger: A research question or literature gap is stated and a hypothesis is wanted. Quiet for protocol steps (design) or when a result file is the input (update).
directives.doneWhen: jq -e over the hypothesis record passes: non-empty measurement, direction (increase, decrease, no-change), and control; or the record carries status rejected-not-runnable with a reason, which is a valid result. A missing field with no rejection status fails.
directives.forbidden: Keeping a hypothesis that cannot be run (vague measurement, no direction, or no control) as runnable instead of rejecting it.

directives.trigger: An accepted hypothesis record and a list of materials the lab already has are present. Quiet when asked to run the protocol or start an instrument.
directives.doneWhen: Only a scientist can accept the plan: the draft lists materials on hand, ordered steps, and the single failure that would kill the idea, then stops at awaiting scientist acceptance. No program passes it.
directives.forbidden: Treating the draft as accepted, starting hardware, or listing a material the lab does not have as if it were on hand.
directives.gate: ABSENT hardware-start, accept (prepare the plan, stop; a scientist accepts and a person starts any instrument)

directives.trigger: Raw tabular or sequencing data files are present and a result is wanted. Quiet for proprietary instrument dumps no script can read: report unsupported.
directives.doneWhen: The verifier, not the script's author, reruns the analysis script in a clean directory with only the raw files; exit code 0 passes. Non-zero, missing script, or skipped rerun means nothing is claimed; unsupported input is a valid result.
directives.forbidden: Reporting a number or figure the script did not produce, or hiding single-outlier dependence: if dropping one point flips the result, say so.

directives.trigger: An old hypothesis record and a result file are both present. Quiet when no result file exists or a new hypothesis from scratch is wanted.
directives.doneWhen: One program over the update record, old hypothesis record, and result file passes only if every cited quote equals the text at its file:line locator, every old branch id is in exactly one of dropped or kept, every dropped branch points at a cited quote, and proposed next measurements number at most 1. No change forced (nothing dropped, zero measurements) is a valid result.
directives.forbidden: Keeping a dead branch because it was the old one, citing a result not in the file, or proposing more than the next measurement.

directives.trigger: Result files and a figure exist and a draft is wanted. Quiet when no result files exist or when the ask is a verdict on the claim.
directives.doneWhen: One program scans the single draft file, body and self-review alike, and flags each line holding a number with no file:line locator in a result file or a verdict or settled-claim word, and flags a self-review section whose heading lacks the word DRAFT; it passes when it flags zero lines. A draft with no self-review or an empty draft for empty results is valid.
directives.forbidden: Upgrading the draft self-review into a verdict, or stating a claim as settled; the human owns the claim.
